description: Modify an existing booking: passenger name or phone, date or time, flight number, passenger count or special requests. Identity is the booking reference plus the email address used on the booking (the same login as the website manage-booking page); the API rejects a mismatch. The email on a booking cannot be changed by this tool: it is the customer's key to the booking. A change request goes to info@aplcars.com from the original address, quoting the booking reference.

booking_ref.description: Booking reference — the numeric reservation ID shown on the confirmation email and the manage-booking page (e.g. "1013869"), or the same number in "APL-<id>" form (e.g. "APL-1013869"). Both formats accepted.

changes.description: Object containing the fields to change

passenger_phone.description: New phone number with country code

email.description: Passenger email on the booking — required, must match exactly

name: amend_booking
